description: Whether the person has paid at the checkout link yet. Use it after hip_create_checkout, while waiting for payment; once paid is true, use hip_get_order for printing, shipping and tracking. Payment truth comes from the order record Stripe's webhook creates, never from a browser redirect. Returns paid, state and order_status, plus order_id once paid.

job_handle.description: the job_handle that hip_create_job returned (job_ followed by 32 hex characters). Only the API key that created the job can use it.

name: hip_get_checkout_status
title: Check payment status
